output.summary: KEP-5307 adds per-container restartRules so kubelet restarts a container on specified exit codes, even when the Pod has restartPolicy=Never. The KEP is at status implementable, stage beta.
output.rationale: AI/ML training Pods must distinguish retryable failures (restart in place) from hardware failures (reschedule the Pod), which restartPolicy alone cannot express. The design adds a container-level restartRules field, with the Job controller unaffected because kubelet restarts keep the Pod Running. Reviewers pushed for a coherent restart story across pod restartPolicy, container restartPolicy and rules, and the PR was approved as an incremental step.

alternatives.option: Add a new RestartPolicy enum value such as RuleBased
alternatives.why_not: Reviewer thockin noted RestartPolicy overloads the meaning to include sidecar, and the thread concluded a new enum value could not be added; the restartRules name was kept instead.

alternatives.option: Use restartPolicy OnFailure at the Pod level
alternatives.why_not: The readme says OnFailure does not work because hardware failures must produce a Pod failure and rescheduling, and the pod failure policy is not compatible with OnFailure.

alternatives.option: Redesign restart semantics first with a new exitCodes-based restartPolicy model
alternatives.why_not: The sources show this was proposed by thockin as a broader design, but the PR was narrowed to restartRules as a targeted per-container addition; the sources do not record a final decision to adopt that model.

evidence.quote: This will allow users to configure special exit codes of the container to be treated as non-failure and restart the container in-place even if the Pod has a restartPolicy=Never.
this PR only introduces `restartRules` as a targeted, per-container override and does not change the existing `restartPolicy`.
API LGTM overall - all my comments are minor and this doesn't have to be final API /approve
I remain some concerns, but those concerns shouldn't block we move forward this alpha feature.
So I accept that I am going to be grumpy. I think we CAN get to a place where container `restartPolicy` is less restricted
